messages:
ivan_customer: Hey team — seeing a high rate of errors from our webhook consumer after switching to structured JSON mode for tool calls. The model sometimes returns malformed args and our parser throws a 400 -> downstream 500. Example payload below from recent request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d

ivan_customer: Request (POST /v1/generate):
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "open-compat/templated-v1",
    "input": "Create user object for onboarding",
    "functions": [{"name":"create_user","parameters": {"type":"object","properties": {"id":{"type":"string"},"profile":{"type":"object"}},"required":["id","profile"]}}],
    "function_call": "auto"
  }'
```

ivan_customer: Model output we received (literal):
```json
{
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "create_user",
    "arguments": '{\"id\": \"user_123\", \"profile\": {\'email\': \'a@example.com\',}, }'
  }
}
```

ivan_customer: Note the arguments field is a string containing single quotes and a trailing comma — our JSON parser fails on it. This hit production at 10:12 UTC and caused the consumer to drop the payload. Can you advise workaround and what the long-term fix is?

maria_support: Thanks for the report — sorry about the outage. Can you paste the full X-Request-Id header you see (from Redwood response) and confirm model + region? Also roughly how often this occurs (error rate %)?

ivan_customer: X-Request-Id: rq_0a1b2c3d, model: open-compat/templated-v1, region: us-west1. Error rate ~1.2% of function-call responses in the last 24h (spiky).

maria_support: Reproducing locally now, will try to capture the raw tokens. If still happening I'll escalate to eng with logs. One quick workaround: set function_call to {"name":"create_user"} explicitly and force temperature=0 to reduce sampling variance. Also add a pre-parse sanitizer to defensively normalize single quotes / trailing commas until we fix it.

alex_engineer: Looping in eng. From the snippet it looks like the model emitted a string inside arguments instead of a JSON object — sometimes sampling causes quoting issues. Two immediate action items: 1) we should detect when arguments is a string and attempt to parse/clean it server-side before returning to customers, 2) add a validation step: if parsed args fails JSON schema validation, automatically trigger a 0-temp retry with an instruction to strictly follow the schema.

lauren_sre: Adding logs from our side for rq_0a1b2c3d: 
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:43Z] rq_0a1b2c3d input len=78 temp=0.2 function_call=auto
[2026-03-17T10:12:43Z] model raw tokens: ... \"arguments\": '\"id\": \"user_123\", \"profile\": {\'email\': \'a@example.com\',}, ' ...
[2026-03-17T10:12:43Z] parse_error: JSONDecodeError at char 14
[2026-03-17T10:12:43Z] downstream_error: consumer 500 on /hooks/user_create
```

alex_engineer: Thanks lauren — that token trace confirms occasional mixed quoting. We'll prioritize a fix in the runtime to: sanitize argument strings, prefer returning a structured object (not a quoted string), and add deterministic schema-enforced retries.

maria_support: In the short term I recommended the customer implement a quick sanitizer: replace single quotes inside the arguments string and remove trailing commas before feeding to json.loads. Example: safe_args = re.sub(r"(?<=\{|,)\'", '"', raw) and re.sub(r",\s*}\", '}', safe). Not perfect but mitigates the 1.2% failure spike.

ivan_customer: Appreciate the immediate workarounds. Any ETA on the runtime fix? We rely on downstream webhooks and need a more robust guarantee — willing to take a canary if you push it.

alex_engineer: We'll ship a canary change to the serving runtime in the next 48 hours to add pre-parse sanitization + an automatic retry at temp=0 when schema validation fails. I'll follow up in this thread with rollout IDs and a link to the canary dashboard. For now please enable the explicit function_call + temp=0 workaround to reduce risk.

maria_support: Marking this as "escalated -> eng-runtime" and adding the customer to the canary access list. I'll ping again once the canary is deployed. :pray:
